The regular expression used to parse the `convolution` filter exhibits exponential-time backtracking for certain inputs, enabling a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS).

### Details
The RegExp for `convolution` is defined as `convolution\((?:\s*((?:[-]?[\d]+\.?[\d]*[;])*(?:[-]?[\d]+\.?[\d]*))\s*)(?:,\s*([\d]+)\s*)(?:,\s*([Tt]rue|[Ff]alse|1|0)\s*)?\)`. Within this expression a dangerous subpattern effectively behaves like `(\d+)*,\d+`.

### PoC
A filter string containing many repeated values will exhaust `re.match`:
- `convolution(-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11)`
- http://localhost:8888/unsafe/0x0/smart/filters:convolution(-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11;-11)/x.png

The evaluation occurs on https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor/blob/master/thumbor/filters/__init__.py#L189.

### Impact
A specially crafted URL will lead to denial of service, as new images won't be processed until `re.match` returns.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-07-31T18:58:28Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-53504"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-07-31T18:58:28Z", "references": ["https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor/security/advisories/GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j", "https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor/commit/3f38fe1610d20168e91f76d432212de30727eb2e", "https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor/releases/tag/7.8.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/thumbor/thumbor/security-advisories/GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor", "summary": "Thumbor has Regex Denial of Service (ReDoS) in `convolution` filter", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-07-31T18:58:29Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-5vjc-7cxw-4w6j", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "7.8.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "thumbor"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 7.7.7"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
